value.notes: First turn: probing basics. Plan: check pause+move same tick, dash recharge HUD, spikes, enemy contact, restart, Enter in dialogs.

Run 2 showed score 100 -> 65136 after stepping on spikes at (3,3) (lives 3->2). Expected score to floor at 0 (500 penalty). Suspected unsigned wrap: 100-500=-400 -> 65136. Verifying with minimal tokens (no coin before spikes).

reports.title: Spike penalty wraps score negative to 65136
reports.observed: Stepping onto spikes with score below 500 makes the score wrap around (e.g. 100 -> 65136) instead of clamping at 0.
reports.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but score never goes below 0, so it should show 0.

value.notes: Run 3 reproduced score wrap (100-500 -> 65136). Trying shorter 2-token dash path: dash-down from (1,1) to (1,3), dash-right onto spikes (3,3). Expect score 0-500 -> 65036 with lives 2. If confirmed, finalize report with this minimal sequence.

reports.title: Spike penalty wraps score negative to a large positive value
reports.observed: Stepping on spikes with score 100 set score to 65136 (wrapped unsigned) instead of flooring at 0.
reports.expected: Spike penalty of 500 floors score at 0 (never negative).

value.notes: Previous 2-token dash-right failed: dash cooldown was 5 after dash-down, so dash-right became a plain step (ended (2,3), score 100). Score wrap needs score>0 before spikes; the coin at (1,3) via dash-down gives 100. Testing 3-token path: dash-down (coin, to (1,3)), right (2,3), right (3,3) spikes. Expect score 100-500 -> 65136, lives 2. If confirmed, finalize with these 3 tokens. Also consider: the 4-token run [down down right right] was already reproduced.

reports.title: Spike penalty wraps score negative to a large positive value
reports.observed: Score 100 minus spike penalty of 500 shows 65136 (wraps around) instead of clamping at 0.
reports.expected: Score never negative: spike penalty of 500 should clamp score at 0.

value.notes: Confirmed the score wrap bug with a 3-token replay from a fresh game (seed 42): dash-down collects the coin (score 100), then right and right step onto the spikes at (3,3). Score goes 100 - 500 = -400 and displays as 65136 (a 16-bit wrap), and lives drop to 2. Design says score never goes below 0. Budget is nearly exhausted, so I am finishing here. Other areas (pause, dialogs, levers, gates, enemies, timer, completion) were not thoroughly tested.

reports.title: Spike penalty wraps score negative to a large positive value
reports.observed: After collecting a coin (score 100), stepping onto spikes subtracts 500 and the score shows 65136 (wrapped from -400). Lives drop to 2.
reports.expected: Score never goes below 0. Spikes should floor the score at 0, so the score should read 0 after the spike hit.
